swap.'s mood drops after Instagram. What do I: 's friends are all online after school. What do I say?

stubs.body:
Being taken out on purpose is meant to hurt, so start with Sam, not the group.

**Do not tell him to just leave.** Say it was meant to hurt and it did, then ask who did it and whether it is happening to anyone else.

**Keep a record.** Screenshot the removals with dates, so a word with school is about a pattern, not a feeling.

Group chats is on Sam's check in now, and I will ask how the week went. The words are in [Taken out of the group on purpose](/dashboard/scripts/9611).

**Tonight.** Mute the group for the night and agree to decide next steps tomorrow.

actions.text: All hell has broken loose on the Year 6 group chat. Sam's been taken out of it.
